name: Elektra

abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

signatureAbility:
No Loose Ends
Elektra's Final Strike now triggers anytime the opponent is below 25% Health. Additionally, while the opponent is within Final Strike range, Elektra gains [22.73 - 562.6] increased Critical Damage Rating.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: While the opponent has less than 15% Health, this Champion strikes with guaranteed Critical Hits.
Opponents passively suffer 85% reduced Defensive Ability Accuracy for as long as they are under a Debuff effect.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack has 100% Critical Hit Chance against bleeding targets.
75% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [5,405.4] Direct Damage over 7 seconds.
If this Bleed fails due to Immunity, Armor Break the target, reducing Armor Rating by [1,500] for 9 seconds.
